teaser.en: A rare climbing shrub of the southern Kenya coast, one of three Keetia species that share the name mnyundzu.
teaser.sw: Kichaka adimu kinachopanda cha pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya, mojawapo ya spishi tatu za Keetia zinazoshiriki jina mnyundzu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka adimu chinachokpwera cha pwani ya kusini ya Kenya; ni aina mwenga kahi ya aina tahu za Keetia zinazoihwa *mnyundzu*.

summary.en: This mnyundzu is Keetia lukei, a shrub of the coffee family. Pakia records one Digo name, mnyundzu, for three species of Keetia.
summary.sw: Mnyundzu huu ni Keetia lukei, kichaka cha familia ya mibuni. Pakia anaandika jina moja la Kidigo, mnyundzu, kwa spishi tatu za Keetia.
summary.dg: *Mnyundzu* uhu ni Keetia lukei, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa. Pakia anaandika dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, *mnyundzu*, kpwa aina tahu za Keetia.

about.en:
*Keetia lukei* was described by botanists only in 1994. It is a climbing shrub or liana.

Like other plants of the genus, it has opposite leaves with small stipules between the leaf stalks, small greenish-white flowers in clusters at the leaf bases, and small fleshy fruits that are often two-lobed and ripen to black. Pakia's informants identified the *mnyundzu* plants by their leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Keetia lukei* ilielezwa na wataalamu wa mimea mwaka 1994 tu. Ni kichaka kinachopanda au mtambaa mkubwa wa mbao (liana).

Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, ina majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana yenye vikanzu vidogo (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe katika vishada kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo yenye nyama ambayo mara nyingi yana pande mbili na huiva kuwa meusi. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea ya *mnyundzu* kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
Asayansi a mimea akaeleza *Keetia lukei* mwaka 1994 tu. Ni chitsaka chinachokpwera, au mmea mure wa nyama za muhi unaokpwera mihi.

Dza mimea yanjina ya jenasi ihi, una makodza ganayolengana mairi-mairi, genye makodza madide sana (*stipules*) kahi ya milita ya makodza; maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani, ganayomera kpwa mabunda phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda; na matunda madide genye nyama, ambago mara nyinji gana seemu mbiri na ganaivwa na kukala maru. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya mimea ya *mnyundzu* kpwa makodza na matunda gao.

where.en: It is native to southern Kenya, where it grows in dry coastal bush and thicket.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini mwa Kenya, unaoota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini ya Kenya, ambapho unamera weruni kavu na vitsakani vya pwani.

names.en: Pakia gives *mnyundzu* for three *Keetia* species: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* and *K. zanzibarica*. To Digo speakers they are one kind of plant. He gives no meaning for the name, and no other language shares it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mnyundzu* kwa spishi tatu za *Keetia*: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* na *K. zanzibarica*. Kwa Wadigo, hizi ni aina moja ya mmea. Hatoi maana ya jina hili, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayolitumia. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mnyundzu* kpwa aina tahu za *Keetia*: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* na *K. zanzibarica*. Kpwa atu anaogomba Chidigo, ni aina mwenga ya mmea. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.en: Vangueria, a close relative in the coffee family
reason.sw: Vangueria, jamaa wa karibu katika familia ya mibuni
reason.dg: Vangueria, ndugu wa phephi wa jamii ya kahawa

reason.en: Rytigynia, of the same group of the coffee family
reason.sw: Rytigynia, wa kundi lilelile la familia ya mibuni
reason.dg: Rytigynia, wa kundi mwenga ndani ya jamii ya kahawa

digo_proposals.name: Mnyundzu
digo_proposals.note: also given for Keetia venosa, Keetia zanzibarica
